1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 g6 3.Nc3 d5 4.cxd5 Nxd5 5..strategy: Recaptures with the b-pawn, completing the large centre of pawns on c3, d4 and e4. White gets space and a free hand for the pieces, at the cost of a weak c3 pawn and a lonely a-pawn, so the centre has to stay active.
Aims the bishop along the long diagonal at the d4 pawn, the base of the white centre, and prepares castling. Black attacks the centre from a distance, and more pressure from the pieces will follow.
